name: Sosipater
description: One of Maccabeus's captains, with Dositheus; went forth with him and slew above ten thousand men whom Timotheus had left in a fortress, and together they later took Timotheus himself but let him go for the saving of their Jewish kinsmen he held

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
